outcome: Utilization of health care services (free medication, free investigations, IFA consumption)
Pregnancy outcomes (cesarean delivery, stillbirths, term deliveries)
cohort: The study included recently delivered postnatal females up to 8-week postpartum who visited the PNC OPD at a tertiary care centre in Etawah district.
finding: Higher maternal health literacy (MHL) was significantly associated with increased utilization of free medication and investigations, higher rates of term deliveries, and lower rates of cesarean delivery and stillbirths.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more common in mothers with limited maternal health literacy (27.7%) compared to those with desired literacy (4.3%, p=0.014).
country: N/A (Etawah district is in India, but the country is not explicitly stated in the abstract)
